sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's EV ecosystem is accelerating via downstream nickel processing and domestic battery manufacturing, directly lifting VKTR and TOBA as vertical integration deepens.

sectors.ai: Buy dips in Indonesian renewables names, especially TOBA, VKTR, and POWR, as domestic momentum (+3.34%) decisively outperforms US peers. The WATCH signal suggests near-term consolidation, but structural drivers—EV adoption, biomass conversion, and captive power demand—remain intact. Rotate from TPIA/BRPT into pure-play climate-tech leaders with stronger volume confirmation.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's middle-class consumption upgrade continues, driven by rising disposable income and urbanization, structurally supporting premium FMCG categories like personal care and beverages.
Digital commerce and social-commerce penetration in Tier-2/3 cities is a durable growth lever, enabling smaller brands like BIKE and ENZO to scale rapidly without traditional retail infrastructure.
Government food-security programs and palm-oil export policies create input-cost volatility, favoring vertically integrated players with domestic sourcing and hedging capabilities.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG laggards with strong rural distribution and digital-led recovery; BIKE, CBUT, and POLU momentum signals confirm domestic demand resilience despite US softness. Rotate into mid-cap staples with pricing power and e-commerce exposure, but trim names lacking volume growth. Watch BI rate path—any cut accelerates consumer spending, favoring high-beta names.
